PH.name: Perfect hindsight
PH.about: The best schedule possible, with every price known in advance. A ceiling, not achievable.

B2.name: 7-day average plan
B2.about: Plans each day on the average of the last 7 days' prices known at bid time.

B4.name: Yesterday's prices
B4.about: Plans each day on the most recent day's prices known at bid time.

B3.name: Same day last week
B3.about: Plans each day on the prices of the same weekday one week earlier.

B1.name: Monthly windows
B1.about: Picks one charge window and one sell window each month from the last 90 days, then repeats them.

B0.name: Fixed 11:00 / 18:00
B0.about: Charges from 11:00 and sells from 18:00 every day.

T1.name: Day-ahead plan, corrected in real-time
T1.about: Commits the 7-day average plan in day-ahead at noon; at 22:00, re-plans on a blend of the next day's day-ahead prices and last week's real-time prices, and trades the difference in real-time.

XF.name: Best market per block, chosen ahead
XF.about: At noon the day before, buys each block in whichever market last week's prices say is cheaper and sells in the dearer.

units.monthly_rs_mw: ₹ per MW of power in the month, after fees and wear
units.lakh_mw_yr: ₹ lakh per MW per year, after fees and wear
